properties.description: A dependency declaration records the source, the version a design MEANS to depend on, the parts taken and the build switches forwarded by name; `reconcile_dependencies` compares that against what the build actually resolves and reports both opposite failures — the build taking something nothing declares, and a declaration the build no longer takes. `dependency_manifest` emits `reflow2.toml`, stamped with which reflow2 produced it. Declaring nothing reads as "nobody has said", never as "depends on nothing".
properties.name: Declare which version of another design you depend on, and check it against the build
